notes.subject: שיפוח
notes.rationale: 'De i pulim win' (win i blow, ASV 'be cool') vs KJV 'the day break' — namba tu reading.

notes.subject: בתר
notes.rationale: Betser — nem bilong ples (KJV, BSB) vs 'ol maunten bilong separesen' (YLТ) vs 'ol maunten bilong spais' (JPS, olsem 'besamim').

notes.subject: עפר האילים
notes.rationale: עפר i minim 'das' tu — pikinini dia i gat kala bilong das; Tok Pisin i no gat dispela kain tok.

notes.subject: ⟨win⟩
notes.rationale: Sipela Tok Pisin i laikim wanpela tok moa long skelim 'pulim' — Hibru i no gat tok 'win' hia.

notes.subject: kirap go raunabaut, man bilong mi
notes.rationale: Meri i singautim man bilong en bilong kirap bek — tok bilong pulim.

notes.subject: to man bilong mi
notes.rationale: Tok i go stret long man bilong meri.

translation: Inap long taim de i pulim ⟨win⟩ na ol sanba i ranawe, kirap go raunabaut, olsem bilong yu, man bilong mi, olsem dia o pikinini dia, long ol maunten bilong Betser.
